correctness.rationale: For q>=3 pairwise distinct runs with total period p, cyclic Parikh windows of residual length r have repeated vectors only in one phase block; sliding changes at phase s iff x_s != x_(s+r). Therefore A(r)=p-sum_i((a_i-r)_++(a_i-p+r)_+) with A(0)=1. Each positive-part summand is convex symmetric; maximizing interval [min(M,p-M),max(M,p-M)] and peak min(p,2(p-M)) follow immediately. Independently enumerated Parikh vectors for every q=3 or 4 run tuple with lengths 1..4 and every residual length, all 320 profiles agreed.
residual_risks: Finite cross-checks are corroboration, not universal proof.
